title: deps: the daily OSV scan has been red since at least 2026-10-26 on 6 public advisories; bump `@hono/node-server` (a shipped dependency of plugin-hono-server and client), `qs` and `systeminformation`, and decide `deepmerge` (no fixed version)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a scheduled gate red on every run, with each failure named. Filed by the triage seat from its schedule-health read. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Red

`Validate Dependencies` → job `Validate Package Dependencies` → step "Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities (OSV-Scanner)" over `pnpm-lock.yaml` fails on every scheduled run read: 10-26, 10-27, 10-28, 10-29 and 10-30, each about 03:03Z. The latest run reports 6 public advisories in 4 packages:

| Advisory | Package | In tree | Fixed in | Note |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f (5.3) | `@hono/node-server` | 2.1.1 | 2.1.3 | **direct, shipped**: `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server` and `packages/client` declare `^2.1.1` |
| GHSA-6pq8-jhm2-2vcw (6.3) | `qs` | 6.16.0 | 6.16.1 | transitive |
| GHSA-3f7j-7jwc-fxfj (7.8), GHSA-4vjg-vx72-qq4g (3.3), GHSA-7648-jmwf-vw7j (6.5) | `systeminformation` | 5.33.1 | 5.33.16 | transitive |
| GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 (5.3) | `deepmerge` | 4.3.1 | none published | transitive |

The scan also reports an unused ignore in `osv-scanner.toml`: `GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c`.

## Wanted

- **Bump to the fixed versions.** `@hono/node-server` goes to `^2.1.3` in both manifests. `qs` and `systeminformation` are refreshed through the lockfile, or through a `pnpm.overrides` entry if a parent pins them, measured.
- The lockfile is regenerated with the repo's tooling, never by hand. A changeset goes on the two published packages.
- **`deepmerge` has no fixed release.** Measure its reach: who pulls it in, and whether that path is runtime or dev-only. ⛔ Adding an ignore loosens a gate, so it is the maintainer's call. The PR proposes the ignore entry with its reason, in the style of the existing `GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5` reason, and the maintainer approves it there. Otherwise the parent is replaced.
- Remove the unused `GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c` ignore.
- Acceptance: the next scheduled `Validate Dependencies` run is green.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:server` lane. `@hono/node-server` sits in two server-lane packages. The lockfile and `osv-scanner.toml` ride with it.

## Dedupe

Read every open issue and PR whose title or body names `OSV`, `osv-scanner`, `@hono/node-server`, `systeminformation`, `deepmerge` or the advisory IDs: no hit.
